prompt: A maker wants to establish a quality baseline before releasing an agent and detect regressions after every significant change to instructions or knowledge. Which Copilot Studio capability should be used?

options.text: The Evaluate tab, which runs a saved test set and scores the responses
The Preview tab, which records quality metrics for each interactive chat session
The Monitor tab, which replays production conversations against the current instructions
The Activity tab, which lists every run with status and duration

explanation: Der Preview-Tab ist für schnelle, informelle Checks – ohne Metriken und ohne wiederholbare Läufe. Der Evaluate-Tab führt ein gespeichertes Testset aus, bewertet die Antworten und speichert jeden Lauf separat, sodass sich Baseline und spätere Läufe vergleichen lassen.

source.title: Plan and run agent evaluations
source.quote: Results from the Preview tab are informal because they don't record metrics or let you run the same set of inputs across multiple sessions.

prompt: You are building a test set for a support agent that delegates certain requests to a connected specialist agent. Which pair of conversations should the test set include to validate routing?

options.text: A request the main agent should delegate and a similar one it should handle itself
Two in-scope questions phrased differently so the specialist agent is invoked twice in a row
An out-of-scope request and its expected decline message for the specialist
A request with an expected response and the same request without one

explanation: Für Connected Agents gehören positive und negative Routing-Tests ins Testset: eine Anfrage aus der Domäne des Spezialisten (soll delegiert werden) und eine ähnliche außerhalb (soll beim Hauptagenten bleiben). Weitere Szenariotypen: In-scope, Klärungsbedarf, Out-of-scope, Eskalation.

source.title: Plan and run agent evaluations
source.quote: For a connected agent, include both positive and negative routing tests. Confirm that the main agent delegates requests in the specialist's domain and retains requests outside that domain.

prompt: A maker adds expected agent responses to every conversation in a test set and is surprised that the General quality score does not reflect how closely the actual answers match them. Why?

options.text: General quality scores responses against relevance and completeness, not the expected text
Expected responses are compared when the user profile has administrator permissions
The expected responses must be written in the agent's instructions before they are compared
General quality compares responses only for connected-agent delegation conversations

explanation: Die Testmethode General quality bewertet Antworten gegen objektive Qualitätsstandards (Relevanz, Vollständigkeit …) und vergleicht sie nicht mit den optionalen erwarteten Antworten. Diese dienen als Referenz für die eigene manuelle Prüfung.

source.title: Plan and run agent evaluations
source.quote: General quality assessment evaluates responses against quality standards such as relevance and completeness. It doesn't compare responses against optional expected agent responses.

prompt: An evaluation run returns perfect scores, but published employees report access errors when the agent reads a SharePoint knowledge source. Which evaluation setting most likely caused the blind spot?

options.text: The authenticated user profile had broader permissions than the intended users
The test method was set to General quality instead of an expected-response comparison method
The test set contained in-scope conversations and no escalation scenario
The evaluation ran before the agent was published to a channel

explanation: Das Authenticated user profile ist die Identität, mit der die Evaluation Wissensquellen und Tools aufruft. Es sollte die Berechtigungen der Zielnutzer widerspiegeln – sonst bleiben Berechtigungsfehler unentdeckt. Auch nach dem Publish gilt: mit einem Standardnutzerkonto validieren, nicht als Autor oder Admin.

source.title: Plan and run agent evaluations
source.quote: Authenticated user profile: The user identity the evaluation uses when calling knowledge sources and tools. Select a profile that reflects the permissions of your intended users.

prompt: Match each evaluation signal to what the learning content says you should investigate.

right.text: Knowledge may be absent or not retrieved, so the response is partial
The tool name or description may not match the scenario well enough
Connected-agent descriptions overlap or conflict with the main agent's instructions
The connected agent may be unpublished, unshared, unavailable, or in another environment

explanation: Die Ergebnistabelle ordnet Signale Ursachen zu: geringe Vollständigkeit → fehlendes/nicht abgerufenes Wissen; falsches Tool → Tool-Name/Beschreibung; falscher Agent → überlappende Beschreibungen; Delegationsfehler → Connected Agent nicht veröffentlicht, nicht geteilt oder in anderer Umgebung; Capability-Fehler → Verbindung/Berechtigung/Konfiguration.

source.title: Plan and run agent evaluations
source.quote: The connected agent might be unpublished, unavailable, unshared, or in a different environment

prompt: After publication, the Monitor tab shows a falling success rate and one tool with repeated unsuccessful use, while response reactions remain positive. Which issue type is this, and where should you address it?

options.text: A runtime failure; review the affected capability and its connection or service status
A quality defect; reproduce on the Preview tab and refine the instructions
A capacity failure; ask an administrator to review Copilot Credit capacity
A permission failure; test with a typical user and review resource permissions

explanation: Sinkende Erfolgsrate und wiederholte Tool-Fehlschläge deuten auf einen Runtime-Fehler (Verbindung, Konfiguration, externer Dienst). Vor jeder Änderung den Problemtyp bestimmen: Anweisungen zu bearbeiten behebt keine fehlenden Berechtigungen, und eine Verbindung zu ändern ergänzt kein fehlendes Wissen.

source.title: Monitor and improve an agent
source.quote: Choose the type of problem before you make a change. Editing instructions doesn't fix missing permissions, and changing a connection doesn't add missing knowledge.

prompt: The Monitor tab reveals a common question type that the original test set never anticipated. After fixing the instructions, what should the maker do to keep the fix from regressing later?

options.text: Add the scenario as a new Evaluate conversation and rerun the test set
Disable the Monitor tab until the next release so the metrics reset
Rely on the Preview tab, because production conversations cover the scenario
Republish the agent, which automatically converts monitored conversations into tests

explanation: Erkenntnisse aus dem Monitor-Tab erweitern das Evaluationsset: Ein unerwartetes Szenario wird als neue Konversation aufgenommen; nach der Korrektur wird das Set erneut ausgeführt, um den Fix zu bestätigen und Regressionen auszuschließen. So spiegelt das Set mit der Zeit die reale Nutzung wider.

source.title: Monitor and improve an agent
source.quote: When the Monitor tab reveals a scenario you didn't anticipate, add it as a new conversation on the Evaluate tab. Over time, your evaluation set reflects actual agent use, not just the scenarios you originally planned for.

prompt: A maker publishes an agent and adds the Teams and Microsoft Copilot channel but clears Make agent available in Microsoft Copilot. Where is the agent available?

options.text: Only in Microsoft Teams
Only in Microsoft Copilot
In both Teams and Microsoft Copilot
In neither until an administrator approves the submission

explanation: Bleibt „Make agent available in Microsoft Copilot“ aktiviert, ist der Agent in Teams und Microsoft Copilot verfügbar; wird die Option entfernt, nur in Teams. Nach Inhaltsänderungen muss erneut veröffentlicht werden, damit verbundene Kanäle den aktuellen Stand erhalten.

source.title: Publish and validate in channels
source.quote: If you clear this option, the agent is available only in Teams.

prompt: An agent works perfectly for its author in Teams, but a standard employee gets access-denied errors on knowledge answers. Which post-publish failure category is this, and how should validation have been done?

options.text: A permission failure; validate with an account that has the intended users' permissions
A connection failure; reconfigure the connector to use maker-provided credentials for all users
A configuration gap; move the agent to the employee's data region
A capacity failure; request additional Copilot Credits from the administrator

explanation: Veröffentlichen beweist nicht, dass der Agent für alle funktioniert. Fehlt einem Standardnutzer der Zugriff auf SharePoint, Dataverse oder eine andere Ressource, ist das ein Berechtigungsfehler. Deshalb immer mit einem Konto validieren, das die Rechte typischer Nutzer hat – nicht als Autor oder Admin.

source.title: Publish and validate in channels
source.quote: Publishing doesn't prove that the agent works for everyone. Test it with an account that has the same permissions as its intended users.

prompt: An organization wants an approved agent to appear automatically, pinned, for every member of the support team in Teams without each person installing it. Which distribution path provides this?

options.text: Preinstallation via a Teams app setup policy configured by an administrator
An installation link copied from Availability options and sent to the team by email
Shared-user discovery in the Built with Power Platform section of the app store
Publishing the agent to the Demo website channel with Direct Line security

explanation: Verteilungswege: Installationslink (für Nutzer mit Zugriff), Shared-user discovery im App Store, organisationsweite Verfügbarkeit nach Admin-Freigabe und Preinstallation – ein Teams-Admin installiert und pinnt den freigegebenen Agenten per App-Setup-Richtlinie für ausgewählte Nutzer. Alle Wege hängen von Tenant-Richtlinien ab.

source.title: Publish and validate in channels
source.quote: Preinstallation: A Teams administrator can use an app setup policy to install and pin the approved agent for selected users.

prompt: An agent's SharePoint knowledge URL and connector accounts differ between the development and production environments. Which ALM components let the same solution work in both without manual edits after deployment?

options.text: Environment variables for the values and connection references for the accounts
Global variables set in the On Conversation Start topic plus maker-provided credentials for every tool
Two separate solutions, one per environment, each with hardcoded values
A pipeline stage that rewrites the URLs in the topic canvas during import

explanation: Environment variables speichern Werte, die sich je Umgebung unterscheiden (z. B. Site-URL); Connection references sorgen dafür, dass jede Umgebung das passende Connector-Konto verwendet. Beides früh einrichten – nachträglich ist es aufwendiger und fehleranfällig.

source.title: Govern agent lifecycle and costs
source.quote: Environment variables store values that differ between environments, such as a site address.

prompt: A maker finishes an agent in a development environment. Releases to production must require an approval step and be repeatable. Which mechanism moves the solution between environments?

options.text: Power Platform Pipelines, which can require approval before a release
The agent's Share dialog, which grants production users access
The Publish button, which pushes the agent to all environments
The Evaluate tab, which promotes a passing run to production

explanation: Power Platform Pipelines transportieren Lösungen zwischen Umgebungen und können eine Genehmigung vor dem Release erzwingen. Maker stellen typischerweise Deployment-Anfragen und testen nach dem Deployment; konfiguriert wird die Pipeline von Admins bzw. IT.

source.title: Govern agent lifecycle and costs
source.quote: Power Platform Pipelines move solutions between environments. A pipeline can also require approval before a release.

prompt: A team runs a full evaluation after every minor instruction edit and notices Copilot Credit consumption climbing. What does the learning content recommend?

options.text: Run evaluations at key milestones and use Preview for quick checks
Disable the Evaluate tab, because author-run evaluations consume no credits
Move evaluations to the Monitor tab, which reads production data at no cost
Convert the agent to a classic agent so evaluations run without model invocations

explanation: Jede Testkonversation einer Evaluation ruft das Sprachmodell auf und verbraucht Credits. Deshalb Evaluationen zu Meilensteinen planen und Testsets auf häufige Szenarien fokussieren; für schnelle Checks während der Entwicklung den Preview-Tab nutzen. Admins überwachen Kapazität im Power Platform admin center.

source.title: Govern agent lifecycle and costs
source.quote: Run evaluations at key milestones—before initial release and after significant changes—rather than after every minor edit. Use the Preview tab for quick checks during development.

prompt: The Monitor tab shows unexpected failures that do not trace to any tool or connection error, and the agent sometimes returns capacity-related messages. What should the maker do?

options.text: Ask an administrator to check Copilot Credit balance and agent limits
Rewrite the agent's instructions to reduce the length of generated responses and save credits
Reconnect every knowledge source so their permissions are refreshed
Republish the agent to clear the cached conversation sessions

explanation: Ist das Credit-Guthaben der Organisation erschöpft oder ein Agentenlimit erreicht (Capacity failure), antworten Agenten nicht mehr oder liefern Kapazitätsfehler. Solche Fehler ohne Tool-/Verbindungsbezug sind ein Fall für den Admin, der Kapazität und Limits im Power Platform admin center prüft.

source.title: Govern agent lifecycle and costs
source.quote: If you see unexpected failures on the Monitor tab that don't trace to a specific tool or connection error, contact your administrator to check whether the issue is capacity-related.

prompt: A tested agent must move from the test environment to production, where makers should not be able to modify it directly. How should it be exported?

options.text: As a managed solution exported from the Solutions area
As an unmanaged solution so production admins can adjust topics after import
As a .zip download of the agent from Copilot Studio's Settings page
As individual topics exported one by one and imported into a new agent

explanation: Lösungen sind der ALM-Träger für Agenten: Agent (inkl. Topics, Entities, Flows) zur Lösung hinzufügen, exportieren, im Zielumfeld importieren. Für Test- und Produktionsumgebungen als managed exportieren. Einzelne Topics lassen sich nicht migrieren – nur der ganze Agent über eine Lösung.

source.title: Export and import agents
source.quote: If you're moving your agent to a test or production environment, you should export as a managed solution.

prompt: An agent is already in a solution. A maker creates three new topics in Copilot Studio. The next export is missing them. What should the maker do?

options.text: Open the solution, select the agent, and choose Add required objects
Open the solution and select New > Topic to recreate the three topics inside the solution
Nothing; new topics are added to the solution automatically on save
Export the topics from the Topics page and import them into the solution

explanation: Werden nach dem Hinzufügen des Agenten weitere Komponenten wie Topics erstellt, müssen sie über „Add required objects“ am Agenten in der Lösung ergänzt werden. Subkomponenten sollten in Power Apps nicht manuell verändert oder entfernt werden, sonst kann der Export scheitern.

source.title: Export and import agents
source.quote: If you add more components to your agent, such as creating new topics, you can add these to the solution by selecting Add required objects from the agent in the solution as shown here.

prompt: A colleague needs to build agents in an environment where the Copilot Studio solutions are already installed, but they cannot create anything. Which security role must an administrator assign in the Power Platform admin center?

options.text: Agent author
Agent transcript viewer
Basic User
System Customizer

explanation: Die Copilot-Studio-Rollen sind Agent author, Agent contributor und Agent transcript viewer. Wer in einer Umgebung Agenten bauen soll, bekommt Agent author (Settings > Users + permissions > Security roles > Members > Add people). Beim Teilen eines Agenten mit einem Nutzer ohne ausreichende Rechte wird zusätzlich Environment maker zugewiesen.

source.title: Environments in Microsoft Copilot Studio
source.quote: Assign yourself the security role of "agent author" in the environment.

prompt: An agent must require sign-in and be published to a custom website as well as Microsoft Teams. Which authentication option should you configure?

options.text: Authenticate manually with an OAuth2 provider such as Microsoft Entra ID
Authenticate with Microsoft, which sets up Entra ID automatically for all channels
No authentication, with web channel security enabled instead
Authenticate with Microsoft plus a Direct Line secret for the website

explanation: „Authenticate with Microsoft“ richtet Entra ID für Teams automatisch ein, macht aber nur den Teams-Kanal verfügbar. Für andere Kanäle mit Authentifizierung ist „Authenticate manually“ mit einem OAuth2-kompatiblen Anbieter (Entra ID, Microsoft-Konto, Google, Facebook, eigener Dienst) nötig. Änderungen wirken erst nach dem Publish.

source.title: Authentication
source.quote: Only the Teams channel is available if you select this option. If you need to publish your agent to other channels but still want authentication for your agent, choose Authenticate manually.

prompt: With manual authentication configured, the maker selects Require users to sign in. What is the effect?

options.text: A system topic is created that prompts users to sign in at the start
A custom topic is created that can be disabled from the Topics page at any time
The Authenticate action becomes available in the Greeting topic only
The agent switches to the Teams-specific Authenticate with Microsoft mode

explanation: „Require users to sign in“ erzeugt das System-Topic „Require user to sign in“, das Nutzer zu Beginn der Konversation anmeldet und Variablen wie User.Id, User.DisplayName, User.Email und User.IsLoggedIn bereitstellt. Ohne diese Option kann die Authenticate-Aktion an beliebiger Stelle im Gespräch aufgerufen werden; Nutzer werden je Sitzung nur einmal angemeldet.

source.title: Authentication
source.quote: Alternatively, you can select the Require users to sign in option, which creates a system topic for Require user to sign in. This prompts the user to sign in as soon as they begin the conversation with the agent.

prompt: You register an app in Microsoft Entra ID for an agent's manual authentication. Which redirect URI must the app registration use?

options.text: https://token.botframework.com/.auth/web/redirect with Web as the platform
https://copilotstudio.microsoft.com/.auth/callback with Single-page application as the platform
The agent's Demo website URL with Mobile and desktop as the platform
https://login.microsoftonline.com/common/oauth2/nativeclient with Public client as the platform

explanation: Für die manuelle Authentifizierung wird eine App-Registrierung mit Redirect URI https://token.botframework.com/.auth/web/redirect (Plattform Web) angelegt; Client-ID und Client-Secret werden dann in Copilot Studio unter Settings > Security > Authentication mit Service Provider Azure Active Directory v2 eingetragen. Token exchange URL ist optional für SSO.

source.title: Authentication
source.quote: The Redirect URI should be https://token.botframework.com/.auth/web/redirect with Web as the platform.

prompt: A sensitive agent is reachable through the Demo and Custom website channels by anyone who knows the agent ID. The organization wants only its own websites to be able to talk to the agent. What should be enabled?

options.text: Web channel security with Require secured access using Direct Line secrets or tokens
Authenticate with Microsoft, which removes the Demo website and Custom website channels
The Everyone in my organization access setting under Security
A DLP policy that blocks the Demo website connector in the environment

explanation: Mit Direct-Line-basierter Sicherheit (Settings > Security > Web channel security > Require secured access) müssen Kanäle ihre Anfragen mit einem Secret oder einem daraus erzeugten Token authentifizieren; Zugriffe ohne diese Absicherung funktionieren nicht. Das Deaktivieren kann bis zu zwei Stunden dauern.

source.title: Administer and manage
source.quote: With Direct Line-based security, you can enable access to only the locations that you control by enabling secured access with Direct Line secrets or tokens.

prompt: Finance asks when a billed session for a classic agent ends. Which statement matches the learning content?

options.text: After 30 minutes without a new message, after 60 minutes in total, or after 100 turns; only then does a new session begin
After 15 minutes without a new message, after 24 hours total, or after 50 turns
Only when the user explicitly closes the chat session in the client
When the agent escalates to a human agent, regardless of the session duration

explanation: Eine abgerechnete Sitzung beginnt mit dem Auslösen eines Nutzer-Topics und endet, wenn 30 Minuten keine neue Nachricht kommt, wenn sie länger als 60 Minuten dauert (die nächste Nachricht startet eine neue Sitzung) oder nach mehr als 100 Turns (der 101. Turn startet eine neue).

source.title: Administer and manage
source.quote: The session has more than 100 turns. A turn is defined as one exchange between a user and the agent. The one-hundred-and-first turn starts a new session.

prompt: A stakeholder wants the engagement rate, resolution rate, escalation rate, and abandon rate of an agent over the last month. Which Analytics page provides this overview?

options.text: Summary
Sessions
Billing
Customer Satisfaction

explanation: Der Summary-Tab zeigt Gesamtsitzungen, Engagement-, Resolution-, Escalation- und Abandon-Rate. Customer Satisfaction zeigt, welche Topics den größten Einfluss haben; Sessions liefert Rohdaten mit Transkripten; Billing die abrechenbaren Interaktionen.

source.title: Administer and manage
source.quote: Information such as total number of sessions, engagement rate, resolution rate, escalation rate, and abandon rate can help you to understand how effective the agent is and to determine the areas that need improvement.

prompt: The Topics list shows a red error count next to one topic. What is the fastest way to find where the error originates?

options.text: Select the error count to open the canvas and read the Topic checker
Open the Sessions analytics page and download the raw transcripts for that topic
Export the agent as a solution and inspect the topic XML
Disable the topic and re-enable it to trigger a revalidation

explanation: Status und Fehler werden am besten auf Topic-Ebene diagnostiziert: Die Topics-Liste zeigt Ein/Aus, Fehler und wer gerade bearbeitet; ein Klick auf die Fehlerzahl öffnet den Canvas, der Topic checker zeigt die Fehler und ihre Herkunft.

source.title: Monitor and diagnose
source.quote: Selecting the status error number takes you to the canvas, which shows the two errors in the Topic checker feature.

prompt: A maker shares an agent with a colleague so they can co-edit it, and the colleague lacks sufficient environment permissions to run Copilot Studio. What happens?

options.text: The maker is notified that the Environment maker role is assigned to the colleague
Sharing fails until an administrator assigns the System Administrator role
The colleague receives view-only access until they accept an invitation email
The agent is exported as a solution and imported into the colleague's environment

explanation: Beim Teilen eines Agenten mit einem Nutzer ohne ausreichende Umgebungsrechte wird die Rolle Environment maker zugewiesen, damit der Nutzer den Agenten bearbeiten kann – mit entsprechender Benachrichtigung. Zum bloßen Chatten mit dem Agenten ist keine Freigabe nötig.

source.title: Administer and manage
source.quote: When you're sharing the agent, if the specified user doesn't have sufficient permissions to use Microsoft Copilot Studio agent in the environment, you're notified that the Environment maker security role is assigned to the person so that they can use the agent.

prompt: Operations wants runtime visibility into connector activity from published agents inside their existing Azure monitoring stack. Which capability does the learning content name for this?

options.text: Application Insights, via Copilot Studio's Azure Monitor integration
The Flow checker, which reports connector failures per run in the designer
Purview activity logging under the CUAOperation term
The Sessions analytics export, which includes connector telemetry

explanation: Sowohl vorgefertigte als auch Custom Connectors bringen Fehlerbehandlung und Antwort-Parsing mit; ihre Aktivität lässt sich über Application Insights im Rahmen der Copilot-Studio-Integration mit Azure Monitor überwachen. Purview/CUAOperation betrifft Computer-Use-Auditlogs.

source.title: Compare action integration patterns
source.quote: Both types include built-in error handling and response parsing, and connector activity can be monitored through Application Insights as part of Copilot Studio's integration with Azure Monitor.

prompt: A classic agent should answer unmatched questions from its knowledge sources instead of asking users to rephrase twice and then escalating. Which mechanism provides this?

options.text: Generative answers as a fallback via the Conversational boosting system topic
A custom prompt tool added to the Escalate system topic so it answers first
Content moderation set to Low so more sources are searched
Enhanced search results, which require a Microsoft 365 Copilot tenant

explanation: Jeder Agent enthält das System-Topic Conversational boosting, das läuft, wenn kein Topic zur Nutzerfrage passt; mit generativen Antworten sucht es in den konfigurierten Wissensquellen. Content moderation (Low/Medium/High) steuert nur die Relevanzstrenge der Antworten.

source.title: Generative AI
source.quote: All agents include a Conversational boosting topic. This topic runs when your agent is unable to identify a topic that addresses the user's question.
